MemberCreateRequest.title: Create program member request
MemberCreateRequest.description: Request body for creating a program member. No additional properties are allowed.

type.description:
Defines how the customer is identified for the member creation. If `customer_id` is provided, the customer is identified by their unique Voucherify customer ID. Then, pass the required `customer_id` string.

If `customer_source_id` is provided, the customer is identified by their source ID (e.g. from an external system). Then, pass the required `customer_source_id` string.

customer_id.description: Unique Voucherify customer ID of an existing customer to enroll as a member. Required when `type` is `customer_id`.

customer_source_id.description: Source ID from an external system of an existing customer to enroll as a member. Required when `type` is `customer_source_id`.

status.description: Initial member status. Defaults to `ACTIVE` when omitted or `null`.

metadata.description: Free-form metadata attached to the member. Validated against the metadata schema defined for the `vl_member` related object (when one is configured). Defaults to an empty object.

MemberBatchCreateRequest.description: Request body for batch member creation - a JSON array of member entries. The raw body is limited to 10485760 bytes (10 MB) and is processed asynchronously in batches of 100 entries. Each entry is validated like a single member creation request during background processing; per-entry failures (invalid customer_id format, unknown customer, invalid status, member already exists) are reported in the async action result.

MemberUpdateRequest.description: Request body for updating a program member. Only metadata is updatable. No additional properties are allowed.

metadata.description: Member metadata to apply. Object keys are merged into existing metadata (omitted keys are preserved). Validated against the `vl_member` metadata schema when configured. Pass `null` to clear all metadata.

MemberBatchCreateResponse.description: Result of scheduling the members batch creation.

async_action_id.description: ID of the scheduled async action processing the batch.

AdjustCardPointsRequest.description: Request body for a manual card points adjustment. No additional properties are allowed.

points.description: Number of points to adjust. Positive values add points (`ADMIN_CREDIT` transaction), negative values subtract points (`ADMIN_DEBIT` transaction), zero results in no transaction (`NO_CHANGE`).

reason.description: Optional reason for the adjustment, stored in the transaction details.

id.description: Unique member ID.

customer_id.description: Unique Voucherify ID of the customer enrolled as this member.

program_id.description: Unique Voucherify ID of the loyalty program the member belongs to.

status.description: Current member status. `INACTIVE` member can't earn points or redeem rewards.

metadata.description: Free-form metadata attached to the member (empty object when none).

created_at.description: Timestamp when the member was created (ISO 8601).

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the member was last updated (ISO 8601), or `null` if never updated.

object.description: Object type marker, always `member`.

MemberWithCards.description: A loyalty program member together with its loyalty cards. Returned by member create and get endpoints.

cards.description: Member's loyalty cards - one per card definition assigned to the program. Card codes are generated asynchronously, so `card.code` may be `null` right after member creation.

Membership.description: A loyalty membership - the member's full loyalty profile within a program, combining the member, the program, and the member's loyalty cards with tier progress.

program.description: The loyalty program the member belongs to.

cards.description: Member's loyalty cards - one per card definition assigned to the program, each enriched with tier progress. Card codes are generated asynchronously, so `card.code` may be `null` right after member creation.

object.description: Object type marker, always `membership`.

MembershipCard.description: A membership's loyalty card - the member's assignment to the card (`member_role`, `created_at`) combined with the card details in the `card` object and the member's tier progress on this card.

tier_progress.description: The member's tier progress on this card. Omitted on endpoints that don't enrich cards with tier progress.

MemberCard.description: A member's loyalty card - the member's assignment to the card (`member_role`, `created_at`) combined with the card details in the `card` object.

member_role.description: Role of the member on this card. Currently, loyalty program members can have only the `OWNER` role.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the card was assigned to the member (ISO 8601).

card.description: The loyalty card details, or `null` when the card is not available.

object.description: Object type marker, always `member_card`.

MemberTierProgress.description: Member's tier progress on a card.

tier_structure.description: Reference to the tier structure the progress relates to, or `null`.

deferred.description: Upcoming tier assignments scheduled to start later, when the tier structure defers tier changes. The member will be assigned to the deferred tier at the start date.

risks.description: Upcoming risks of losing or downgrading the current tier.

opportunities.description: Opportunities to reach higher tiers. Deferred tiers are not included in this list.

object.description: Object type marker, always `member_tier_progress`.

id.description: Tier structure ID.

object.description: Object type marker, always `tier_structure`.

MemberTierProgressDeferred.description: A tier assignment deferred to a future date.

start_at.description: Timestamp when the deferred tier starts (ISO 8601), or `null`.

expires_at.description: Timestamp when the deferred tier expires (ISO 8601), or `null`.

tier.description: Current tier reference, or `null` when the member has no current tier.

expires_at.description: Timestamp when the member's tier expires (ISO 8601), or `null`.

points.description: Member's points position within the tier's points range, or `null`.

current.description: Member's current points counted towards the tier.

tier.description: Tier the member would be downgraded to, or `null` for `TIER_LEFT`.

card_type.description: Card type. Currently only `INDIVIDUAL` is supported.

code.description: Human-readable card code. Card code generation is asynchronous - this field is `null` right after member creation and is populated shortly after, once the background code generation completes.

lifetime_bucket.description: Lifetime point counters of the card.

balance.description: Current available balance calculated from the lifetime bucket.

next_expiration.description: The nearest upcoming point expiration, or `null` when none is scheduled.

CardLifetimeBucket.description: Lifetime points counters of a card.

points.description: Lifetime counters of regular (active) points.

CardLifetimeBucketPoints.description: Lifetime counters of regular points. All counters default to 0. The available balance is calculated as: `total` - `subtracted` - `expired` - `spent` - `refunded` + `returned` - `locked` + `unlocked` - `purchased_reversed`.

total.description: Total accumulated points, including points added manually, earned by fulfilling earning rules and activated from pending points (excluding returned points).

earned.description: Total points earned by fulfilling earning rules (does not include activated pending points or points added manually).

purchased.description: Total points purchased via a `LOYALTY_CARD_POINTS` reward (credited to the target card).

purchased_reversed.description: Total purchased points reversed via reward refund.

refunded.description: Total refunded points (points that were earned by products which were later returned).

returned.description: Total returned points (by returning a purchased reward).

locked.description: Total locked points (by locking a purchased reward).

unlocked.description: Total unlocked points (by unlocking a purchased reward).

CardLifetimeBucketPendingPoints.description: Lifetime counters of pending points. The available pending balance is max(`total` - `activated` - `canceled`, 0).

details.description:
Card transaction details. `reason`, `rejection` and `metadata` are present on all variants; the remaining fields depend on the transaction `type`:

- `ADMIN_CREDIT`: `points` (`total`, `expiration_date`)
- `ADMIN_DEBIT`: `points` (`total`)
- `ADMIN_POINTS_EXPIRATION`: `bucket` (the expired points bucket)
- `POINTS_EARNED`: `points` (`total`, `expiration_date`)
- `POINTS_EXPIRED`: `points` (`total`), `date`, `buckets`
- `POINTS_SPENT_ON_REWARD`: `points` (`total`), `reward`, `reward_transaction`,`target_card`, `purchase_transaction`
- `POINTS_PURCHASED`: `points` (`total`, `expiration_date`, `expiration_type`), `reward`, `reward_transaction`, `card_transaction`
- `POINTS_PURCHASE_REVERSED`: `points` (`total`, `expiration_date`,
  `expiration_type`), `reward`, `purchase`, `reward_transaction`
- `POINTS_SPENT_ON_ORDER`: `points` (`total`), `order`, `order_transaction`
- `POINTS_REFUNDED`: `points` (`total`)
- `POINTS_RETURNED`: `points` (`total`, `expiration_date`, `expiration_type`), `reward`, `purchase`, `reward_transaction`
- `PENDING_POINTS_ADDED` / `PENDING_POINTS_ACTIVATED` / `PENDING_POINTS_CANCELED`: `points` (`total`, `date`, `type`)

status.description: Transaction status. `PENDING` — created, awaiting processing; `PROCESSING` — being processed; `APPROVED` — completed successfully; `REJECTED` — rejected (see `details.rejection`); `SIMULATED` — dry-run create result, not persisted (not returned by list).

details.description: Transaction details for the `PAY_WITH_POINTS` type.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the transaction was created (ISO 8601).

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the transaction was last updated (ISO 8601), or `null`.

object.description: Object type marker. Always `order_transaction`.

reason.description: Human-readable reason: "Points spent on order payment".

rejection.description: Rejection details, present when the transaction was rejected.

metadata.description: Transaction metadata. For pay-with-points transactions this contains the flattened payment limits used for the calculation: `amount_limit` for the `AMOUNT_LIMIT` type and/or `points_limit` for the `POINTS_LIMIT` type. Empty object when the default `CARD_BALANCE` limit was used or when not set.

amount_limit.description: Maximum amount limit applied to the payment (if any).

points_limit.description: Maximum points limit applied to the payment (if any).

id.description: Payment identifier. Omitted when not set.

amount.description: Amount of the order paid with points.

points_spent.description: Number of points spent on the payment.

exchange_ratio.description: Points-to-amount exchange ratio evaluated from the card definition's pay-with-points formula.

OrderPaymentRejection.description: Rejection details for a rejected order payment transaction.

reason.description: Machine-readable rejection reason. Order-side: `ORDER_NOT_FOUND`, `PAYMENT_EXCEEDS_ORDER_TOTAL_AMOUNT`. Card-side (when the linked card transaction fails first): `NOT_ENOUGH_BALANCE`, `GLOBAL_SPENDING_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`, `TRANSACTION_SPENDING_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`.

details.description: Structured rejection context. Omitted when the reason carries no extra data (`ORDER_NOT_FOUND`, `PAYMENT_EXCEEDS_ORDER_TOTAL_AMOUNT`, `NOT_ENOUGH_BALANCE`). For `GLOBAL_SPENDING_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`: `type`, `limit`, `spendings`. For `TRANSACTION_SPENDING_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`: `type`, `limit`.

type.description: Spending cap type that was exceeded.

spendings.description: Projected total spendings that exceeded the limit. Present for `GLOBAL_SPENDING_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`.

transaction.description: An order transaction representing a pay-with-points `SIMULATED` payment.

program_id.description: Unique identifier of the loyalty program (format `lprg_...`).

member_id.description: Unique identifier of the program member (format `lmbr_...`).

status.description: Transaction status. `SIMULATED` — dry-run create result, not persisted.

status.description: Result status. `DRY_RUN` for dry-run mode.

message.description: Human-readable result message. `DRY_RUN` mode: "Dry run mode. No transaction was created. This is only a simulation.".

junction.description: Joins field filters with `AND` or `OR`. Defaults to `AND`.

id.description: Filter by order transaction id.

created_at.description: Filter by creation date.

OrderPaymentFilterIdConditions.description: ID filter conditions for order transaction ids. Values must match pattern `^lotx_[a-f0-9]+$`. `$is`/`$is_not` accept a single value (string or 1-element array); `$in`/`$not_in` accept a string or an array of 1-100 values.

$is.description: Matches transactions whose id equals the given value.

$is_not.description: Matches transactions whose id does not equal the given value.

$in.description: Matches transactions whose id is one of the given values.

$not_in.description: Matches transactions whose id is not one of the given values.

OrderPaymentFilterDateConditions.description: Date filter conditions. `$before`/`$after` accept an ISO date-time string. `$is`/`$more_than`/`$less_than` accept a non-negative integer number of days ago. `$has_value`/`$is_unknown` accept any single value and match rows where the field is set / not set. Single values may also be passed as 1-element arrays.

$before.description: Matches rows with the date before the given date-time.

$after.description: Matches rows with the date after the given date-time.

$is.description: Matches rows with the date exactly the given number of days ago.

$more_than.description: Matches rows with the date more than the given number of days ago.

$less_than.description: Matches rows with the date less than the given number of days ago.

$has_value.description: Matches rows where the date field is set.

$is_unknown.description: Matches rows where the date field is not set.

CardDefinitionCreateRequest.description:
Request body for creating a card definition.
Cross-field rules apply: `balance_settings.allow_negative: true` requires
`points_expiration.type` to be `NO_EXPIRATION`; the earned points refund mode
`REVOKE_BELOW_ZERO` requires `allow_negative: true`; and the earned points refund
method `REVOKE_FROM_PENDING` requires `pending_points.type` to be `PERIOD_BASED`,
`FIXED_DATES` or `EVENT_BASED`.

type.description: Card definition type. Currently only `INDIVIDUAL` is supported.

status.description: Initial status. Allowed values on create are `DRAFT` and `ACTIVE`. Defaults to `DRAFT` when omitted.

code_config.description: Card code generation configuration. Defaults to a 10-character alphanumeric pattern.

pending_points.description: Pending points activation policy. Defaults to `IMMEDIATE`.

earning_limits.description: Points earning limits. Defaults to `NO_LIMIT` for both global and transaction limits.

spending_limits.description: Points spending limits. Defaults to `NO_LIMIT` for both global and transaction limits.

refunds.description: Refund handling configuration. Defaults to `NONE` for both spent and earned points.

balance_settings.description: Card balance settings. Defaults to `allow_negative: false`.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata attached to the card definition.

CardDefinitionUpdateRequest.description:
Request body for updating a card definition.
All properties are optional. `type` and `status` cannot be updated.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata attached to the card definition.

CardDefinitionCodeConfigInput.description:
Card code generation configuration.
When `pattern` is provided, the effective code length is the number of `#`
placeholders in the pattern; otherwise `length` (default 10) `#` placeholders are used.

length.description:
Number of generated characters in the code (ignored when `pattern` is provided).
A positive integer. Defaults to 10.

charset.description: Characters used for code generation. Defaults to alphanumeric: `0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ`.

prefix.description: Fixed prefix prepended to every generated code. Defaults to an empty string.

postfix.description: Fixed postfix appended to every generated code. Defaults to an empty string.

pattern.description: Code pattern where each `#` is replaced with a random character from the charset, e.g. `###-###`. Defaults to `#` repeated `length` times.

CardDefinitionPointsExpirationInput.description:
Points expiration policy.
Conditional requirements based on `type`:
- `NO_EXPIRATION`: `rolling_expiration`, `calendar_expiration` and `sliding_expiration` must be null/absent.
- `ROLLING_EXPIRATION`: `rolling_expiration` is required; the other two must be null/absent.
- `CALENDAR_EXPIRATION`: `calendar_expiration` is required; the other two must be null/absent.
- `SLIDING_EXPIRATION`: `sliding_expiration` is required; the other two must be null/absent.

rolling_expiration.description: Rolling expiration configuration. Required when `type` is `ROLLING_EXPIRATION`, must be null otherwise.

calendar_expiration.description: Calendar expiration configuration. Required when `type` is `CALENDAR_EXPIRATION`, must be null otherwise.

sliding_expiration.description: Sliding expiration configuration. Required when `type` is `SLIDING_EXPIRATION`, must be null otherwise.

CardDefinitionPointsExpirationRollingExp.description: Rolling expiration configuration - points expire after a fixed period from earning.

rounding.description: Optional rounding applied to the calculated expiration date.

CardDefinitionPointsExpirationRollingExp.description:
Rolling expiration period. The maximum `value` depends on `unit`:
1-90 for `DAY`, 1-12 for `MONTH`, 1-5 for `YEAR` (enforced via if/then conditions).

value.description: Period length. Maximum: 90 for `DAY`, 12 for `MONTH`, 5 for `YEAR`.

CardDefinitionPointsExpirationRollingExp.description:
Rounding of the rolling expiration date. When `type` is `END_OF_PARTICULAR_MONTH`,
`value` (month number 1-12) is required; for all other types `value` must be null/absent.

value.description: Month number (1-12). Required when `type` is `END_OF_PARTICULAR_MONTH`, must be null otherwise.

CardDefinitionPointsExpirationCalendarEx.description: Calendar expiration configuration - points expire on fixed calendar dates.

expiration_dates.description: List of calendar dates on which points expire (1-20 dates).

CardDefinitionPointsExpirationCalendarEx.description:
A calendar date (day + month). The maximum `day` depends on `month`
(enforced via if/then conditions): 29 for February, 30 for April/June/September/November,
31 for the remaining months.

day.description: Day of the month. Maximum depends on the month: 29 for February, 30 for April, June, September, November, 31 otherwise.

CardDefinitionPointsExpirationSlidingExp.description:
Sliding expiration configuration - points expiration slides on member activity.
At least one of `earning_activity`, `spending_activity` or `custom_activity` must be `true`.
When `custom_activity` is `true`, `custom_activity_types` is required with 1-10 unique
custom event schema IDs.

earning_activity.description: Whether earning points resets the expiration window.

spending_activity.description: Whether spending points resets the expiration window.

custom_activity.description: Whether the configured custom events reset the expiration window.

custom_activity_types.description:
Custom event schema IDs (pattern `^ms_[a-zA-Z0-9]+`) that reset the expiration window.
Required with 1-10 unique items when `custom_activity` is `true`.

CardDefinitionPointsExpirationSlidingExp.description:
Sliding expiration period. The maximum `value` depends on `unit`:
1-90 for `DAY`, 1-12 for `MONTH`, 1-1 for `YEAR` (enforced via if/then conditions).

value.description: Period length. Maximum: 90 for `DAY`, 12 for `MONTH`, 1 for `YEAR`.

CardDefinitionPendingPointsInput.description:
Pending points activation policy.
Conditional requirements based on `type`:
- `IMMEDIATE`: `period_based`, `fixed_dates` and `event_based` must be null/absent.
- `PERIOD_BASED`: `period_based` is required; the other two must be null/absent.
- `FIXED_DATES`: `fixed_dates` is required; the other two must be null/absent.
- `EVENT_BASED`: `event_based` is required; the other two must be null/absent.

type.description: Pending points activation type. `IMMEDIATE` means no pending period.

period_based.description: Period-based activation. Required when `type` is `PERIOD_BASED`, must be null otherwise.

fixed_dates.description: Fixed-dates activation. Required when `type` is `FIXED_DATES`, must be null otherwise.

event_based.description: Event-based activation. Required when `type` is `EVENT_BASED`, must be null otherwise.

CardDefinitionPendingPointsPeriodBasedIn.description: Period-based pending points activation - points activate after a fixed period.

CardDefinitionPendingPointsPeriodBasedPe.description:
Pending period. The maximum `value` depends on `unit`:
1-90 for `DAY`, 1-12 for `MONTH`, 1-1 for `YEAR` (enforced via if/then conditions).

value.description: Period length. Maximum: 90 for `DAY`, 12 for `MONTH`, 1 for `YEAR`.

CardDefinitionPendingPointsFixedDatesInp.description: Fixed-dates pending points activation - points activate on fixed calendar dates.

dates.description: List of calendar dates on which pending points activate (1-20 dates).

CardDefinitionPendingPointsFixedDatesDat.description:
A calendar date (day + month). The maximum `day` depends on `month`
(enforced via if/then conditions): 29 for February, 30 for April/June/September/November,
31 for the remaining months.

day.description: Day of the month. Maximum depends on the month: 29 for February, 30 for April, June, September, November, 31 otherwise.

CardDefinitionPendingPointsEventBasedInp.description: Event-based pending points activation - points activate when one of the configured custom events occurs, or are cancelled after the cancel period.

event_types.description: Custom event schema IDs (pattern `^ms_[a-zA-Z0-9]+`) that activate pending points. 1-10 unique items.

CardDefinitionPendingPointsEventBasedCan.description:
Period after which non-activated pending points are cancelled. The maximum `value`
depends on `unit`: 1-90 for `DAY`, 1-12 for `MONTH`, 1-1 for `YEAR`
(enforced via if/then conditions).

value.description: Period length. Maximum: 90 for `DAY`, 12 for `MONTH`, 1 for `YEAR`.

CardDefinitionEarningLimitsGlobalInput.description:
Global (per card) earning limits. When `type` is `NO_LIMIT`, `limits` must be
empty or `null`; when `type` is `LIMITED`, `limits` must contain exactly 1 limit.

limits.description: Limit definitions. Empty/null when `type` is `NO_LIMIT`; exactly 1 item required when `type` is `LIMITED`.

CardDefinitionEarningLimitsGlobalLimitIn.description:
A global earning limit, discriminated by `type`:
`BALANCE_BASED` (maximum card balance) or `TIME_BASED` (maximum points earned per period).

oneOf.description: Balance-based limit - the card balance cannot exceed `max` points.
Time-based limit - at most `points.max` points can be earned per period.

CardDefinitionEarningLimitsGlobalTimeBas.description:
Time-based earning limit period. When `type` is `CURRENT_PERIOD` (the only
allowed value), `current_period` is required.

type.description: Period type. Currently only `CURRENT_PERIOD` (current calendar period) is supported.

CardDefinitionEarningLimitsGlobalTimeBas.description: Calendar period unit used to reset the time-based earning limit.
Points cap for the time-based earning limit.

max.description: Maximum points that can be earned within the period (1 to 9007199254740991).

CardDefinitionEarningLimitsTransactionsI.description:
Per-transaction earning limits. When `type` is `NO_LIMIT`, `limits` must be
empty or `null`; when `type` is `LIMITED`, `limits` must contain at least 1 limit.
Each limit `type` may appear at most once in the array.

limits.description: Limit definitions with unique types. Empty/null when `type` is `NO_LIMIT`; at least 1 item required when `type` is `LIMITED`.

CardDefinitionEarningLimitsTransactionsL.description:
A per-transaction earning limit, discriminated by `type`:
`POINTS` (maximum points earned per transaction) or `SPENDING`
(minimum order amount required to earn points).

oneOf.description: Points limit - at most `max` points can be earned in a single transaction.
Spending threshold - points are only earned when the transaction amount is at least `min_amount`.

min_amount.description: Minimum transaction amount required to earn points.

CardDefinitionSpendingLimitsGlobalInput.description:
Global (per card) spending limits. When `type` is `NO_LIMIT`, `limits` must be
empty or `null`; when `type` is `LIMITED`, `limits` must contain exactly 1 limit.

limits.description: Limit definitions. Empty/null when `type` is `NO_LIMIT`; exactly 1 item required when `type` is `LIMITED`.

CardDefinitionSpendingLimitsGlobalLimitI.description:
A global spending limit, discriminated by `type`:
`SPENDING_BASED` (total points spent) or `TIME_BASED` (points spent per period).

oneOf.description: Spending-based limit - at most `max` points can be spent in total.
Time-based limit - at most `points.max` points can be spent per period.

CardDefinitionSpendingLimitsGlobalTimeBa.description:
Time-based spending limit period. When `type` is `CURRENT_PERIOD` (the only
allowed value), `current_period` is required.

type.description: Period type. Currently only `CURRENT_PERIOD` (current calendar period) is supported.

CardDefinitionSpendingLimitsGlobalTimeBa.description: Calendar period unit used to reset the time-based spending limit.
Points cap for the time-based spending limit.

max.description: Maximum points that can be spent within the period (1 to 9007199254740991).

CardDefinitionSpendingLimitsTransactions.description:
Per-transaction spending limits. When `type` is `NO_LIMIT`, `limits` must be
empty or `null`; when `type` is `LIMITED`, `limits` must contain exactly 1 limit.

limits.description: Limit definitions. Empty/null when `type` is `NO_LIMIT`; exactly 1 item required when `type` is `LIMITED`.

CardDefinitionSpendingLimitsTransactions.description: A per-transaction spending limit. Currently only the `POINTS` type is supported.

oneOf.description: Points limit - at most `max` points can be spent in a single transaction.

CardDefinitionRefundsSpentPointsInput.description:
How points spent on a refunded order are handled. When `type` is `NONE`,
`methods` must be empty or `null`; when `type` is `REFUNDABLE`, `methods`
must contain exactly 1 method.

methods.description: Refund methods. Empty/null when `type` is `NONE`; exactly 1 item required when `type` is `REFUNDABLE`. Currently only one method is allowed.

CardDefinitionRefundsSpentPointsMethodIn.description: A spent points refund method. Currently only the `RETURN_POINTS` type is supported.

oneOf.description: Return spent points back to the card.

mode.description: Refund mode: on full-order refund (`REFUND_ALL`), per-item refund (`REFUND_ITEM`) or amount-based refund (`REFUND_AMOUNT`).

CardDefinitionRefundsEarnedPointsInput.description:
How points earned on a refunded order are handled. When `type` is `NONE`,
`methods` must be empty or `null`; when `type` is `REFUNDABLE`, `methods`
must contain exactly 1 method.

type.description: Whether earned points are revocable on refund.

CardDefinitionListFilters.description:
Filters for the card definitions list endpoint. Each field accepts a
`conditions` object; provided conditions must be valid for the field type.

junction.description: Logical junction between field filters. Defaults to `AND`.

id.description: Filter by card definition ID.

status.description: Filter by card definition status (`ACTIVE` or `DRAFT` only).

created_at.description: Filter by creation date.

updated_at.description: Filter by last update date.

CardDefinitionIdFilter.description:
ID field filter. Allowed conditions:
`$is`, `$is_not`, `$in`, `$not_in`. Values must match the card definition ID pattern
`^lcdef_[a-f0-9]+$`. `$is`/`$is_not` accept a single value (string or 1-element array);
`$in`/`$not_in` accept 1-100 values.

$is.description: ID equals the given value.

$is_not.description: ID does not equal the given value.

$in.description: ID is one of the given values (up to 100).

$not_in.description: ID is none of the given values (up to 100).

CardDefinitionStringFilter.description:
String field filter. Allowed conditions: `$is`, `$is_not`, `$contains`, `$not_contain`,
`$starts_with`, `$ends_with`, `$in`, `$not_in`, `$has_value`, `$is_unknown`.
Single-value conditions accept a string or a 1-element array; `$in`/`$not_in`
accept 1-10 values; `$has_value`/`$is_unknown` are presence checks and ignore the value.

$is.description: Value equals the given string.

$is_not.description: Value does not equal the given string.

$not_contain.description: Value does not contain the given substring.

$starts_with.description: Value starts with the given prefix.

$ends_with.description: Value ends with the given suffix.

$in.description: Value is one of the given strings (up to 10).

$not_in.description: Value is none of the given strings (up to 10).

$has_value.description: Field has a value (presence check; the provided value is ignored).

$is_unknown.description: Field has no value (presence check; the provided value is ignored).

CardDefinitionTypeFilter.description:
Enum field filter for the card definition `type` field. Allowed conditions:
`$is`, `$is_not`, `$in`, `$not_in`.
Values must be one of: `INDIVIDUAL`.

$is.description: Type equals the given value.

$is_not.description: Type does not equal the given value.

$in.description: Type is one of the given values (up to 10).

$not_in.description: Type is none of the given values (up to 10).

CardDefinitionStatusFilter.description:
Enum field filter for the card definition `status` field. Allowed conditions:
`$is`, `$is_not`, `$in`, `$not_in`.
Values must be one of: `ACTIVE`, `DRAFT` (deleted card definitions are not listable).

$is.description: Status equals the given value.

$is_not.description: Status does not equal the given value.

$in.description: Status is one of the given values (up to 10).

$not_in.description: Status is none of the given values (up to 10).

CardDefinitionDateFilter.description:
Date field filter. Allowed conditions:
`$before`, `$after`, `$is`, `$more_than`, `$less_than`, `$has_value`, `$is_unknown`.
`$before`/`$after` accept a date string; `$is`/`$more_than`/`$less_than` accept a
non-negative integer (number of days); `$has_value`/`$is_unknown` are presence checks.
Single values may be passed as a string or a 1-element array.

$before.description: Date is before the given date (a date string).

$after.description: Date is after the given date (a date string).

$is.description: Date matches the given value expressed as a non-negative integer number of days.

$more_than.description: Date is more than the given non-negative integer number of days ago.

$less_than.description: Date is less than the given non-negative integer number of days ago.

$has_value.description: Field has a value (presence check; the provided value is ignored).

$is_unknown.description: Field has no value (presence check; the provided value is ignored).

CardDefinitionActivityListFilters.description: Filters for the card definition activities list endpoint.

junction.description: Logical junction between field filters. Defaults to `AND`.

id.description: Filter by activity ID.

created_at.description: Filter by activity creation date.

CardDefinitionActivityIdFilter.description:
ID field filter for activity IDs. Allowed conditions:
`$is`, `$is_not`, `$in`, `$not_in`.
Values must match the card definition activity ID pattern `^lacd_[a-f0-9]+$`.
`$is`/`$is_not` accept a single value; `$in`/`$not_in` accept 1-100 values.

$is.description: Activity ID equals the given value.

$is_not.description: Activity ID does not equal the given value.

$in.description: Activity ID is one of the given values (up to 100).

$not_in.description: Activity ID is none of the given values (up to 100).

CardDefinitionActivityTypeFilter.description:
Enum field filter for activity types. Allowed conditions:
`$is`, `$is_not`, `$in`, `$not_in`.
Values must be one of: `vl.card_definition.created`, `vl.card_definition.updated`,
`vl.card_definition.deleted`, `vl.card_definition.activated`,
`vl.card_definition.deactivated`, `vl.card_definition.drafted`,
`vl.card_definition.assigned`, `vl.card_definition.unassigned`.

$is.description: Activity type equals the given value.

$is_not.description: Activity type does not equal the given value.

$in.description: Activity type is one of the given values (up to 10).

$not_in.description: Activity type is none of the given values (up to 10).

error.description: Default error returned when rule validation fails. Can be `null`.

validity_hours.description: Hours during which the rule is active. Can be `null`.

rules.description: Validation rules group evaluated before applying effects. Can be `null`.

effects.description: Effects applied when the rules match.

EarningRuleRulesGroup.description: Group of rule definitions combined by a logical formula. Besides `logic`, only positive-integer keys are allowed (property names must match `^[1-9]\d*$`), each referencing a rule definition. The `logic` value is a logical expression referencing the numbered rules, e.g. `"1 and 2"` or `"1 and (2 or 3)"`. At least one numbered rule is required (`minProperties: 2` including `logic`).

logic.description: Logical expression combining the numbered rule definitions, e.g. `"1 and 2"`.

name.description: Rule definition name. Which names are allowed depends on the trigger event: `customer.order.paid` allows customer.* plus all order.* names; `customer.custom_event` allows customer.* plus custom_event.metadata; `customer.segment.entered` allows only customer.* names.

property.description: Metadata property name the rule applies to (for metadata-based rules). Can be `null`.

schema_id.description: Custom event schema ID for custom_event.metadata rules. Can be `null`.

error.description: Error returned when this specific rule fails. Can be `null`.

EarningRuleConditions.description: Conditions keyed by operator. Allowed operators: `$is`, `$is_not`, `$in`, `$not_in`, `$less_than`, `$less_than_or_equal`, `$more_than`, `$more_than_or_equal`, `$from` (each an array of values), and `$dow` (an array of day-of-week integers 0-6). At most 10 operator properties are allowed (`maxProperties: 10`).

^(\\$is|\\$is_not|\\$in|\\$not_in|\\$les.description: Condition values - strings, integers, booleans or object references.

id.description: Referenced object ID.

object.description: Referenced object type name.

source_id.description: Source ID of the referenced object. Can be `null`.

message.description: Error message shown when validation fails.

EarningRuleEffect.description: Effect applied when an earning is triggered. Depending on `type`, exactly one of `points`, `points_proportional` or `benefit` is required and the others must be null/absent.

EarningRuleEffectPoints.description: Fixed points effect - awards a fixed number of points to a card definition.

value.description: Fixed number of points to award.

card_definition_id.description: Card definition ID (`lcdef_...`) the points are awarded to.

points_expiration.description: Optional expiration override for the awarded points. Can be `null`.

EarningRuleEffectPointsProportional.description:
Proportional points effect - awards points using an "every X gives Y points" formula.
Depending on `calculation_type`, one specific configuration object is required and the
others must be null/absent:
- `PRE_DISCOUNT_ORDER_AMOUNT`: requires `order.amount`
- `POST_DISCOUNT_ORDER_AMOUNT`: requires `order.total_amount`
- `ORDER_METADATA_VALUE`: requires `order.metadata`
- `CUSTOMER_METADATA_VALUE`: requires `customer.metadata`
- `CUSTOM_EVENT_METADATA_VALUE`: requires `custom_event.metadata`
- `PRE_DISCOUNT_ORDER_ITEMS_AMOUNT`: requires `order_items.amount`
- `POST_DISCOUNT_ORDER_ITEMS_AMOUNT`: requires `order_items.subtotal_amount`
- `ORDER_ITEMS_QUANTITY`: requires `order_items.quantity`
The trigger further restricts allowed calculation types:
`customer.order.paid` allows all order/order-items types plus `CUSTOMER_METADATA_VALUE`;
`customer.custom_event` allows `CUSTOMER_METADATA_VALUE` and `CUSTOM_EVENT_METADATA_VALUE`;
`customer.segment.entered` allows only `CUSTOMER_METADATA_VALUE`.

calculation_type.description: How the proportional points are calculated.

card_definition_id.description: Card definition ID (`lcdef_...`) the points are awarded to.

points_expiration.description: Optional expiration override for the awarded points. Can be `null`.

EarningRuleEffectBenefit.description: Benefit effect - grants a predefined benefit.

id.description: Benefit ID (`lben_...`).

EarningRulePointsProportionalEvery.description: "Every X gives Y points" formula based on an amount.

every.description: The divisor - every this amount (e.g. in cents) awards `value` points.

value.description: Points awarded per `every` unit.

EarningRulePointsProportionalMetadata.description: "Every X gives Y points" formula based on a numeric metadata property.

every.description: The divisor - every this metadata value awards `value` points.

value.description: Points awarded per `every` unit.

property.description: Metadata property name holding the numeric value.

EarningRulePointsProportionalApplicableT.description: Criterion selecting order items the calculation applies to. Depending on `type`, exactly one of `product`, `sku` or `products_collection` is required and the others must be null/absent.

id.description: Product ID (`prod_...`).
SKU ID (`sku_...`).
Products collection ID (`pc_...`).

EarningRulePointsProportionalOrderItemsC.description: Order items based calculation - "every X gives Y points" applied to items matching the `applicable_to` criteria.

every.description: The divisor - every this amount/quantity awards `value` points.

value.description: Points awarded per `every` unit.

applicable_to.description: Product/SKU/collection criteria selecting matching order items.

EarningRulePointsProportionalOrder.description: Order-based proportional calculation configuration. `amount` is used by `PRE_DISCOUNT_ORDER_AMOUNT`, `total_amount` by `POST_DISCOUNT_ORDER_AMOUNT` and `metadata` by `ORDER_METADATA_VALUE`.

EarningRulePointsProportionalCustomEvent.description: Custom event based proportional calculation configuration (`CUSTOM_EVENT_METADATA_VALUE`).

EarningRulePointsProportionalOrderItems.description: Order items based proportional calculation configuration. `amount` is used by `PRE_DISCOUNT_ORDER_ITEMS_AMOUNT`, `subtotal_amount` by `POST_DISCOUNT_ORDER_ITEMS_AMOUNT` and `quantity` by `ORDER_ITEMS_QUANTITY`.

EarningRuleEffectPointsExpiration.description: Points expiration override. Depending on `type`, exactly one of `rolling_expiration`, `calendar_expiration` or `sliding_expiration` is required; for `NO_EXPIRATION` all three must be null/absent.

EarningRuleEffectPointsExpirationRolling.description: Rolling expiration - points expire a fixed period after earning.

rounding.description: Optional rounding of the calculated expiration date. Can be `null`.

EarningRuleEffectPointsExpirationRolling.description: Rolling expiration period. The maximum `value` depends on `unit`: `DAY` - 90, `MONTH` - 12, `YEAR` - 5.

value.description: Period length. Maximum depends on `unit`: 90 for DAY, 12 for MONTH, 5 for YEAR.

EarningRuleEffectPointsExpirationRolling.description: Rounding of the rolling expiration date. `value` (the month number, 1-12) is required for `END_OF_PARTICULAR_MONTH` and must be null for all other rounding types.

value.description: Month number (1-12), only for `END_OF_PARTICULAR_MONTH`. `null`able otherwise.

EarningRuleEffectPointsExpirationCalenda.description: Calendar expiration - points expire on fixed calendar dates (1 to 20 dates).
A calendar expiration date. The maximum `day` depends on `month`: 29 for February (month 2), 30 for April/June/September/November (4, 6, 9, 11), 31 for the remaining months.

EarningRuleEffectPointsExpirationSliding.description: Sliding expiration inactivity period. The maximum `value` depends on `unit`: `DAY` - 90, `MONTH` - 12, `YEAR` - 1.

value.description: Period length. Maximum depends on `unit`: 90 for DAY, 12 for MONTH, 1 for YEAR.

EarningRuleListFilters.description: Filters for listing earning rules. Each field carries a required `conditions` object; condition values may be passed as a single string or as an array. Conditions not allowed for the field type are rejected.

junction.description: How multiple field filters are combined. Defaults to AND behaviour. Can be `null`.

id.description: ID filter. Allowed conditions: `$is`, `$is_not` (single value), `$in`, `$not_in` (up to 100 values). Values must match `^lern_[a-f0-9]+$`. Can be `null`.

$is.description: Exactly matches the value (single value).

$is_not.description: Does not match the value (single value).

$in.description: Matches any of the values (up to 100).

$not_in.description: Matches none of the values (up to 100).

name.description: Name filter (string type). Allowed conditions: `$is`, `$is_not`, `$contains`, `$not_contain`, `$starts_with`, `$ends_with` (single value), `$in`, `$not_in` (up to 10 values), `$has_value`, `$is_unknown`. Can be `null`.

status.description: Status filter (enum type). Allowed conditions: `$is`, `$is_not` (single value), `$in`, `$not_in` (up to 10 values). Allowed values: `ACTIVE`, `INACTIVE`, `DRAFT`. Can be `null`.

$is.description: Exactly matches the value (single value).

$is_not.description: Does not match the value (single value).

$in.description: Matches any of the values (up to 10).

$not_in.description: Matches none of the values (up to 10).

created_at.description: Creation date filter. Can be `null`.

EarningRuleStringFilterConditions.description: String field filter conditions. `$is`, `$is_not`, `$contains`, `$not_contain`, `$starts_with` and `$ends_with` take a single value (string or one-element array); `$in` and `$not_in` take up to 10 values; `$has_value` and `$is_unknown` are presence checks (value is ignored).

$is.description: Exactly matches the value.

$is_not.description: Does not match the value.

$in.description: Matches any of the values (up to 10).

$not_in.description: Matches none of the values (up to 10).

$has_value.description: Field has a value (presence check).

$is_unknown.description: Field has no value (absence check).

EarningRuleDateFilterConditions.description: Date field filter conditions. `$before` and `$after` take a date string; `$is`, `$more_than` and `$less_than` take a non-negative integer number of days (relative comparison); `$has_value` and `$is_unknown` are presence checks.

$before.description: Before the given date (single date string).

$after.description: After the given date (single date string).

$is.description: Exactly N days ago (non-negative integer).

$more_than.description: More than N days ago (non-negative integer).

$less_than.description: Less than N days ago (non-negative integer).

$has_value.description: Field has a value (presence check).

$is_unknown.description: Field has no value (absence check).

TierStructureCreateRequest.description: Request body for creating a tier structure. No additional properties are allowed.

name.description: Display name of the tier structure. Required.

type.description:
Tier qualification tracking model. `POINT_BALANCE` qualifies members by their
current point balance; `POINT_EARNED` qualifies members by points earned within
a tracking period. Required.

point_balance.description:
Point balance tracking settings. Required (non-null) when `type` is
`POINT_BALANCE`; must be null/omitted when `type` is `POINT_EARNED`.

point_earned.description:
Points earned tracking settings. Required (non-null) when `type` is
`POINT_EARNED`; must be null/omitted when `type` is `POINT_BALANCE`.

expiration.description:
Tier membership expiration settings. If omitted, defaults to
`{ "type": "NO_RETENTION" }`.

downgrade.description:
Downgrade behavior applied when tier membership expires. If omitted, defaults to
`{ "type": "NO_DOWNGRADE" }`.

metadata.description: Free-form key/value object holding custom attributes.

status.description: Initial status of the tier structure. Defaults to `DRAFT` when omitted.

TierStructureUpdateRequest.description:
Request body for updating a tier structure. All properties are optional; no
additional properties are allowed. When the tier structure is not in `DRAFT`
status, only `name` and `metadata` may be updated.

name.description: Display name of the tier structure.

type.description:
Tier qualification tracking model. If provided, the matching tracking settings
object (`point_balance` or `point_earned`) becomes required.

point_balance.description:
Point balance tracking settings. Required (non-null) when `type` is provided as
`POINT_BALANCE`; must be null when `type` is provided as `POINT_EARNED`.

point_earned.description:
Points earned tracking settings. Required (non-null) when `type` is provided as
`POINT_EARNED`; must be null when `type` is provided as `POINT_BALANCE`.

downgrade.description: Downgrade behavior applied when tier membership expires.

metadata.description: Free-form key/value object holding custom attributes.

TierStructurePointBalanceUpsert.description:
Point balance tracking settings. Members qualify for tiers based on the current
balance of the referenced card definition.

card_definition_id.description: Unique identifier of the card definition whose point balance is tracked.

TierStructurePointEarnedUpsert.description:
Points earned tracking settings. Members qualify for tiers based on points earned
on the referenced card definition within a tracking period.

card_definition_id.description: Unique identifier of the card definition whose earned points are tracked.

period.description: Tracking period during which earned points are accumulated.

type.description:
When a tier change resulting from earned points takes effect: `IMMEDIATELY`
or at the start of the `NEXT_TRACKING_PERIOD`.

TierStructurePointEarnedPeriodUpsert.description:
Points earned tracking period. The maximum `value` depends on `unit`: 90 for
`DAY`, 52 for `WEEK`, 12 for `MONTH`, 5 for `YEAR`.

value.description:
Length of the tracking period, expressed in `unit` units. Minimum 1. Maximum
depends on `unit` (DAY: 90, WEEK: 52, MONTH: 12, YEAR: 5).

TierStructureExpirationUpsert.description:
Tier membership expiration settings. Exactly the sub-object matching `type` is
required; the remaining sub-objects must be null/omitted.

type.description: Expiration model for tier membership. Required.

fixed_duration.description:
Fixed duration expiration settings. Required (non-null) when `type` is
`FIXED_DURATION`; must be null/omitted otherwise.

calendar_expiration.description:
Calendar expiration settings. Required (non-null) when `type` is
`CALENDAR_EXPIRATION`; must be null/omitted otherwise.

sliding_expiration.description:
Sliding expiration settings. Required (non-null) when `type` is
`SLIDING_EXPIRATION`; must be null/omitted otherwise.

TierStructureExpirationFixedDurationUpse.description: Fixed duration expiration settings. Tier membership expires after a fixed period.

period.description: Duration after which the tier membership expires.

value.description: Length of the expiration period, expressed in `unit` units. Minimum 1.

TierStructureExpirationCalendarExpiratio.description: Calendar expiration settings. Tier membership expires on fixed calendar dates.

calendar_dates.description: Calendar dates (day + month) on which tier membership expires. 1-20 items.

TierStructureExpirationCalendarDateUpser.description:
A recurring calendar date. The maximum `day` depends on `month`: 29 for February
(month 2), 30 for April/June/September/November (months 4, 6, 9, 11), and 31 for
the remaining months.

day.description:
Day of the month (1-31). Maximum depends on `month`: February allows up to 29;
April, June, September and November allow up to 30; other months allow up to 31.

TierStructureExpirationSlidingExpiration.description:
Sliding expiration settings. Tier membership expiration slides forward on the
configured member activities.

earning_activity.description: Whether point earning activity extends the tier membership.

spending_activity.description: Whether point spending activity extends the tier membership.

custom_activity.description: Whether custom activities extend the tier membership.

custom_activity_types.description:
Custom activity type names that extend the tier membership. Up to 10 unique
items. Defaults to an empty array when omitted.

items.description: Custom activity type name.

period.description: Sliding period after the last qualifying activity. Required (may be null).

value.description: Length of the sliding period, expressed in `unit` units. Minimum 1.

TierStructureDowngradeUpsert.description:
Downgrade settings. Controls how members are moved to lower tiers on expiration.
When `type` is `NO_DOWNGRADE`, `grace_period` must be null/omitted.

type.description:
Downgrade model. `MULTI_LEVEL` allows dropping multiple tiers at once,
`SINGLE_LEVEL` drops one tier at a time, `NO_DOWNGRADE` disables downgrades.
Required.

grace_period.description:
Grace period before the downgrade takes effect. Must be null/omitted when
`type` is `NO_DOWNGRADE`.

value.description: Length of the grace period, expressed in `unit` units. Minimum 1.

round_up.description: Whether the grace period end is rounded up to the end of the unit.

TierCreateRequest.description: Request body for creating a tier. No additional properties are allowed.

name.description: Display name of the tier. Required.

qualification_rules.description: Rules determining which members qualify for this tier. Required.

downgrade.description:
Tier-level downgrade behavior. If omitted, defaults to `{ "type": "INHERIT" }`
(inherits the tier structure downgrade settings).

metadata.description: Free-form key/value object holding custom attributes.

Tier qualification rules. When `type` is `POINTS`, `points` is required and

and `segment` are required.

segment.description:
Customer segment reference. Required (non-null) when `type` is

Point thresholds for tier qualification. Values must be non-negative numbers
between 0 and 1,000,000,000.

min_value.description: Minimum number of points required to qualify for the tier. Required.

max_value.description: Optional upper bound of points for the tier.

disables downgrades from this tier. Required.
